name: diag_t02_first6_source_manifest_01
command:
import json
from pathlib import Path
from src.envs.pair_table_source import _container
from src.tools.t01_partition import sha_file
picks=[["results/t01v2_checkpoint_flip_geometry_01.json","floorplan203_00002","data/world_pairs/v2/pilot_pairs_v2_flip60_fp203_s15_r01_j707737_hopper_m_02_g0_floorplan203/floorplan203_00002/pair.json"],["results/t01v2_checkpoint_g01_retained_01.json","floorplan301_00049","data/world_pairs/v2/gen_train_concurrency_s15_02_c2_floorplan301/floorplan301_00049/pair.json"],["results/t01v2_checkpoint_g01_retained_01.json","floorplan301_00072","data/world_pairs/v2/gen_train_concurrency_s15_02_c2_floorplan301/floorplan301_00072/pair.json"],["results/t01v2_checkpoint_look60_fp203_02.json","floorplan203_00001","data/world_pairs/v2/pilot_pairs_v2_look60_seq_01_j707558_hopper_m_02_g0_floorplan203/floorplan203_00001/pair.json"],["results/t01v2_checkpoint_flip_geometry_01.json","floorplan204_00038","data/world_pairs/v2/pilot_pairs_v2_flip60_fp204_s15_r01_j707740_hopper_m_02_g0_floorplan204/floorplan204_00038/pair.json"],["results/t01v2_checkpoint_g01_next12_01.json","floorplan207_00009","data/world_pairs/v2/gen_train_next12_60_01_retry1_c6_floorplan207/floorplan207_00009/pair.json"]]
entries=[]
for source,pair_id,pair_file in picks:
 data,ref,rows=_container(source)
 matched=[row for row in rows if row['pair_id']==pair_id and row['pair_reference']['file']==pair_file]
 assert len(matched)==1
 row=matched[0]
 assert sha_file(pair_file)==row['pair_reference']['sha256']
 pair=json.loads(Path(pair_file).read_text())
 assert pair['scene']==row['scene'] and pair['kind']==row['kind']
 entries.append({'source':{'file':ref['file'],'sha256':ref['sha256']},'pair':{'file':pair_file,'sha256':row['pair_reference']['sha256']},'pair_id':pair_id,'proposal_identity':row['proposal_identity'],'scene':row['scene'],'field_of_view':60})
manifest={'version':'t02_explicit_source_units_v1','partition':'train','scope':'first six existing source exports under new shadow rule, including legacy controller and prior distance/hidden-anchor cases; no scientific pass inferred','entries':entries}
path=Path('configs/t02_export_first6.json')
with path.open('x') as stream: json.dump(manifest,stream,indent=2,sort_keys=True);stream.write('\n')
print('PREPARED_T02_MANIFEST: '+json.dumps({'file':str(path),'sha256':sha_file(path),'entries':entries},sort_keys=True))
